title: detection-registry.v1
comment: Per-DETECTION registry entry (plan 025 U1). One entry tracks one detection's identity (detection_id + source), its lifecycle status, its version, a manifest_ref pointing at the SHIPPED Detection Capability Manifest that backs it (detections/manifest/<id>.manifest.json, contracts/detection-capability.schema.json), and an append-only change_history of status transitions. Two rules this contract carries: (1) manifest_ref must look like a detections/manifest/*.manifest.json path (pattern below) AND resolve to a real file on disk — the file-existence half is a consistency check in contracts/test_detection_registry.py, not expressible here; (2) change_history is APPEND-ONLY with prior entries immutable — a store invariant enforced in services/detection-registry/store.py, not in schema. Lifecycle/promotion rules (which transitions are legal) are U2 and deliberately NOT encoded here: any status is a valid `to`, and this schema does not police the transition graph.

status.comment: Lifecycle rung. The legal transition graph between these is U2; this contract treats every value as a valid state.

source.comment: Which detection engine/source family produced this detection.

manifest_ref.comment: Repo-relative path to the backing Detection Capability Manifest. Pattern enforces the shape; file existence is checked in the contract test / store.

change_history.comment: Append-only log of status transitions. The first record carries from=null (creation). Append-only + prior-entry immutability is enforced by the store, not here.

from.comment: Prior status, or null for the creation record.
